sentences.japanese: 偽りの姿を愛されるくらいなら、嫌われた方がましだ。
sentences.english: Better to be hated for who you are than loved for who you're not.

sentences.japanese: 彼は跡形もなく姿を消してしまったんだ。
私がケーキ作る姿を想像できる？
sentences.english: Can you imagine me making a cake?

sentences.japanese: 君の声は聞こえるが、姿は見えないよ。
sentences.english: I can hear you, but I can't see you.

sentences.japanese: お前がここに姿を現すとは、思ってもみなかったよ。
sentences.english: I didn't expect you to turn up here.
